name: Daily Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Job Hunter

values.content:
You are filtering remote jobs for Jerry, who lives in Taiwan.

The most important rule: Jerry must be able to work this job while physically based in Taiwan.

Do NOT pass the job only because it says "remote."

REJECT if:
- Requires the worker to live in the US, Canada, UK, EU, Europe, Australia, or any specific country outside Taiwan
- Requires local work authorization outside Taiwan
- Hybrid, onsite, or remote within one country only
- Requires fixed working hours forcing Jerry to work through the night in Taiwan (e.g. strict 9-5 EST/PST/CET)

KEEP only if one of these is true:
- Says worldwide remote, work from anywhere, or global remote
- Says APAC remote
- Allows international contractors
- Accepts people based anywhere
- Company hires through EOR, Deel, Remote.com, Oyster, or contractor agreement
- No specific country restriction and distributed/async team

Return ONLY valid JSON, no other text:
{
  "taiwan_eligible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "reason": "short reason under 20 words",
  "location_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "timezone_risk": "low/medium/high",
  "contractor_possible": "yes/no/unclear",
  "decision": "keep/reject/manual_check"
}

=Write a short cover letter for Jerry.

Jerry is based in Taiwan and wants async global remote work.

Jerry's background:
- Bilingual English and Mandarin (grew up in California and Taiwan)
- Digital marketing background transitioning into data
- Data science bootcamp: Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI
- Performance marketing, SEO, PPC, GA4, Meta Ads, Google Ads
- AI tools: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor
- Portfolio: dashboards, EDA, machine learning projects, customer segmentation, fraud detection, marketing analytics

Job he is applying to:
Title: {{ $json.job_title }}
Company: {{ $json.company }}
Why good fit: {{ $json.why_good_fit }}
Role category: {{ $json.role_category }}

Job description excerpt:
{{ $json.description.substring(0, 800) }}

Instructions:
- Make it specific to this job and company
- Mention how Jerry can: reduce manual analysis time, improve reporting speed, connect marketing and data, build AI-assisted workflows, turn messy data into business action
- Keep it under 220 words
- Tone: confident, direct, human, not desperate
- Do NOT use generic filler phrases
- End with a clear call to action
- Return ONLY the cover letter text, no subject line or metadata

parameters.subject: =🔥 High Score Job Alert ({{ $json.score }}/100): {{ $json.job_title }} at {{ $json.company }}

notes:
SETUP INSTRUCTIONS
==================

1. GOOGLE SHEETS — Create a sheet called 'Taiwan Eligible Async Remote Jobs' with 4 tabs:
   Sheet 1 (Raw Jobs): date_found | source | job_title | company | job_url | location_text | salary | description | posted_date | tags | job_id
   Sheet 2 (Filtered Jobs): date_found | score | job_title | company | job_url | salary | taiwan_eligible | taiwan_reason | location_risk | timezone_risk | contractor_possible | async_level | role_category | why_good_fit | decision | application_status | notes
   Sheet 3 (Applied): date_applied | job_title | company | job_url | cover_letter_used | status | follow_up_date | notes
   Sheet 4 (Rejected): date_rejected | job_title | company | job_url | reason

2. CREDENTIALS — Replace all REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_* placeholders:
   - REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_CREDENTIAL_ID → your n8n Google Sheets credential ID
   - REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_OPENAI_CREDENTIAL_ID → your n8n OpenAI credential ID
   - REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GMAIL_CREDENTIAL_ID → your n8n Gmail credential ID
   - REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_GOOGLE_SHEET_ID → the ID from your Google Sheet URL
   - REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_EMAIL@gmail.com → your Gmail address

3. ADDITIONAL SOURCES — Wellfound and Otta have no public APIs.
   To add them: duplicate an HTTP Request node, set URL to their job search pages,
   and add source detection logic in the Normalize Jobs code node.

4. AI MODEL — The workflow uses gpt-4o-mini for eligibility checks (fast, cheap)
   and gpt-4o for cover letters (higher quality). Swap for Claude via HTTP Request
   node hitting https://api.anthropic.com/v1/messages if preferred.

5. FIRST RUN — Run manually once to populate Raw Jobs. Duplicates are skipped
   on subsequent runs using job_url as the dedup key.

6. SCORING — Only jobs scoring 70+ go to Filtered Jobs. Score 85+ also trigger
   instant email alert + cover letter draft.
